name: The Electric Utility
archetype: A vertically integrated power utility — generation, transmission, distribution, retail

ca.full: Provincial Utility Regulator (e.g. Ontario Energy Board)
ca.what: Economic regulation — approves transmission and distribution rates, grants licences and sets service-quality and reliability standards.
Federal regulation of international and interprovincial power lines, including certificates, tolls and electricity export permits.
Electrical installation safety — administers the provincial electrical safety code, contractor licensing and serious-incident reporting.

uk.full: Office of Gas and Electricity Markets
uk.what: Economic regulation — RIIO price controls, network and supply licences, and consumer-protection standards.
Workplace and electrical safety — safe systems of work on or near live conductors, and investigation of serious incidents.
Environmental permits for generating stations, water abstraction licences and emissions monitoring and reporting.

roles.title: Board of Directors
roles.about: Governs the utility on behalf of its shareholder(s) and, in practice, the public it serves. Approves strategy, major capital programmes and rate-case positions, and holds the CEO to account for keeping the lights on safely. Works through its Audit & Finance, Safety & Operations, Regulatory and Human Resources committees.
